AccessorListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a property or indexer’s accessor methods, such as {c:color-blue keyword}get{/c} and {c:color-blue keyword}set{/c}.

AttributeListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the attribute list applied to a code element.

CastTypeBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the type used when converting a value to another type.

CatchArgumentBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the exception data provided when an exception is caught.

CollectionExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a collection expression.

DeconstructionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a deconstruction variable list.

InterpolationBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a value or expression embedded inside an interpolated string.

ParenthesizedExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a parenthesized expression.

TupleExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the elements that are grouped together to create a tuple.

TupleTypeBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the elements that make up a tuple.

ArrayTypeFragment.Definition: A fragment of the array type syntax.

AccessorBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of an {c:color-blue keyword}event{/c} {c:color-blue keyword}add{/c} accessor method.

ArgumentListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the argument list passed into a method or constructor call.

AttributeArgumentListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the argument list passed to an attribute.

IndexArgumentListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the value(s) or expression(s) that evaluate to an index used to access an element of the preceeding collection.

ParameterListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the parameter list defined for a method or constructor.

TypeArgumentListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the type argument list supplied to a generic type or method.

TypeParameterListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the type parameter list declared by a type or method.

CatchBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of code that executes after an exception is caught.

ElseBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the code that runs when an {c:color-purple keyword}if{/c} statement condition is false.

IfBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the code that runs when an {c:color-purple keyword}if{/c} statement condition is true.

LambdaExpressionBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a lambda expression block.

TryBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the code that may throw an exception.

ConditionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a value or expression to be evaluated.

ContextBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a code block that the compiler/runtime will treat differently because of the context.

DeclarationBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a type, member, or namespace declaration.

DefaultExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a {c:color-blue keyword}default{/c} expression.

SizeOfExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a {c:color-blue keyword}sizeof{/c} expression.

TypeOfExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a {c:color-blue keyword}typeof{/c} expression.

InitializerBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of an {c:bold}initializer expression{/c}.<break/>Initializer expressions can be identified by curly braces {c:code}{ }{/c} used during object creation.

LoopBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the code that will be executed for each iteration of the loop.

LoopControlBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the logic that determines how many times a loop will execute.

PatternBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a pattern matching clause.

SwitchBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a {c:color-purple keyword}switch{/c} statement or expression.
